Hi, I'm Abhigna. I'm a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash
University with an interest in environmental data and in explaining numbers to people who don't work with them every day.

Before my Masters I studied BBA(Business Analytics).

On this blog I turn research articles into short, plain-language stories.
